notes: Completed story set for explainability layer including schema, logic, API integration, and tests.

EVAL-F5-S55.title: Explainability Schema Definition
EVAL-F5-S55.description: Define a standardized explainability schema (source, meaning, limitations) for all evaluation signals, implemented as Pydantic models to ensure consistent structure across provider and clinical trial outputs.

EVAL-F5-S56.title: Explainability Mapping Logic
EVAL-F5-S56.description: Implement backend logic to map raw evaluation signals from provider_detail_service and clinical_trials_service into the standardized explainability schema, including enrichment of source attribution and human-readable meaning.

EVAL-F5-S57.title: Explainability Integration in Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F5-S57.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include explainability metadata in all evaluation responses returned to the chat layer, ensuring consistent inclusion across provider and clinical trial outputs.

EVAL-F5-S58.title: Explainability Unit and Integration Tests
EVAL-F5-S58.description: Create unit and integration tests to validate that explainability metadata is correctly generated, structured, and propagated through the facade to the frontend, including edge cases for missing or partial data.

EVAL-F5.mitigation: Reuse existing facade and service structures to standardize explainability without introducing new services.
